metaTitle: Network Security That Is Set Up Right | SecuEdge
metaDescription: Firewall, intrusion prevention, antivirus and web filtering in one appliance, with a guided setup that makes the secure choice the easy one.

hero.headline: Network security that's set up right the first time.
hero.sub: Firewall, intrusion prevention, antivirus and web filtering in one appliance, with a guided setup that makes the secure choice the easy one.

challenges.title: Misconfiguration, not malware
challenges.desc: Gartner found that 99% of firewall breaches come from misconfiguration. Most networks are protected by good products set up wrongly, because traditional firewalls are built for specialists.

challenges.title: Built for specialists
challenges.desc: Traditional firewalls assume an expert on call. Most organisations don't have one.

challenges.title: Settings drift
challenges.desc: Without regular review, settings drift and gaps stay open.

approach.title: One choice sets five engines
approach.desc: Quick Mode sets firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, antivirus and DNS filtering together, so nothing is left half-configured.

approach.title: Full control for engineers
approach.desc: Professional Mode gives engineers full control of rules, NAT, VLANs and routing.

approach.title: Every feature on every model
approach.desc: From the smallest desktop unit up — a small site never buys a cut-down box.

approach.title: Logs for audits
approach.desc: Logs and reports per device, exportable for audits.

indiaContext: Data stays in India by default, and SecuEdge Frontier is built with the DPDP Act 2023 in mind.

process.title: Identify
process.desc: We learn how your network is used: how many people, which sites, which systems matter most.

process.title: Analyze
process.desc: We recommend the right model and settings for your risks and your industry.

process.title: Protect
process.desc: Our team or partner sets up SecuEdge Frontier and trains your team.

process.title: Adapt
process.desc: Regular updates, quarterly security reviews and 24/7 India-based support keep you protected as things change.

faqs.q: Do I need a network engineer to run it?
faqs.a: No. Quick Mode is built for business owners and IT generalists. Engineers can switch to Professional Mode at any time.

faqs.q: Will it work with my existing network?
faqs.a: Yes. SecuEdge Frontier sits at your internet edge and works with your existing switches and Wi-Fi. Our team handles the setup.
Choose by the number of people on your network at the busiest time. Use the model finder or ask our team.
In India, by default. Traffic, logs and policy data stay on Indian soil, with no overseas routing.
24/7 technical support from India-based engineers on 1800 123 0966. We respond within 24 hours.
